scope: Original-title artwork identifying the Simpsons: Hit & Run browser port and Skate 3 fan browser port.
selectionNote: The user requested relevant missing thumbnails. The primary agent selected exact original-title artwork as contextual identification. These are not screenshots of the browser ports, and the user did not provide separate image licences or a specific Wikipedia sourcing instruction.
verificationLimits: Source file descriptions, format, dimensions and checksums were checked by the worker. The primary agent visually inspected both downloaded covers.
Source attribution is recorded below. No hosting, game redistribution, streaming or monetisation permission is inferred from artwork availability.

entries.title: Skate 3 — Fan Game
entries.subjectIdentified: Box art of Skate 3 (EA Black Box, published by Electronic Arts, 2010) — the exact underlying title this fan browser port streams user-supplied data for. NOT the fan build at skate.aaddpp.lol, and NOT skate. (2007) or any later series entry.
entries.credits: Skate 3 box art, (c) Electronic Arts Inc. (2010). This is the infobox image of the Wikipedia article 'Skate 3' (file uploaded by a Wikipedia user, 2010-04-18); the Wikipedia file page credits Joystiq / Engadget, 'Skate 3 cover revealed, plus new dev diary and screens', 2010-02-25: https://www.engadget.com/2010/02/25/skate-3-cover-revealed-plus-new-dev-diary-and-screens/
entries.licenseStatus: Wikipedia non-free file (LicenseShortName 'Fair use', NonFree=true, Copyrighted=true, categories 'PlayStation 3 game covers|Xbox 360 game covers|All non-free media'). Used here contextually to identify the original title that the fan port runs. No licence granted, no permission inferred, no notice removed.
caveats: This is original-game artwork identifying a fan browser port. It is not a screenshot of the fan build, and the fan host publishes no artwork of its own (its 9,785-byte HTML has no , no og:image/twitter:image, no favicon link; /og.png, /cover.png, /assets/*.png etc. all returned 404 in the earlier audit).

Anomalous proportions: 270x284 (aspect 0.95) is close to square, whereas PS3/Xbox 360 box art is normally portrait. This is exactly what the Wikipedia article publishes as its box art; the image was not altered. Identity is asserted from that article's file description page, not from visual inspection (this worker had no image-viewing capability). If a portrait or higher-resolution EA press/store copy is wanted, source it separately.
Low resolution for a 460x245 card, and near-square against a 1.88 card window, so the card centre-crops it.
The fan port's own rights in the underlying Skate 3 game and data are unverified; nothing here implies the host or the user may legally run, stream or distribute it.
